changes: Validate and snapshot agent configuration; bound asynchronous connection wait with a configurable 30-second deadline.
Release reservations and resume native queues after failures, cancellation, delegation and destruction; preserve queued connector async context.
Reject invalid socket results and delegation cycles, settle each connection once and destroy late sockets.
Use native structured call sites for protocol inference where supported, without invoking user error formatters.
Copy response chunks on receipt, support exact byte views and UTF-8 strings, enforce optional byte limits and reject invalid UTF-8 JSON without disclosing payloads.
Preserve native HTTP/TLS pooling and synchronous or asynchronous subclass connectors with self-contained public declarations.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Compare TLS pool names against the runtime's native HTTPS Agent method instead of a fixed historical suffix.
Set HTTPS fixture URL protocols explicitly: async-listen 3.1.0 identifies Bun HTTPS servers as HTTP servers. Applied equally to upstream and VPM.
